hook: Landscapers heading into *snow season*: quick quiz
title: Landscapers switching to snow removal: can you get *2/2*?

questions.q: Adding snow removal this winter. Does your landscaping insurance cover it?
questions.why: Not always. Check before the first storm.

questions.q: A crew member's driver's license expired last month. Can they drive the plow truck?
questions.why: Check crew licenses too, not just yours.
